slides.headline: What does it mean?
slides.body: Most business lending decisions weigh several factors together — trading history, cash flow and security — not just a flawless credit file. Many lenders specialise in working with applicants who have a less-than-perfect history.

caption:
“You need perfect credit” is one of the most common myths in business finance — and it stops plenty of viable businesses from even asking the question.

In reality, lenders weigh multiple factors together, and a less-than-perfect credit history is often just one input among several, not an automatic disqualifier.
